elements.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: Section 7.7 expressly states that Customer is not liable for any liquidated damages or penalties under the Agreement.

elements.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: No Customer-payable liquidated amount exists under the rendered clause, so the condition is demonstrably absent.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause neither creates an early-termination fee nor states a three-month cap.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause prohibits all Customer-payable liquidated amounts rather than designating an early-termination fee as the sole payable amount.
